title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE PRANE KOMUNES SE PARISIT
description_sq:
Prona pozicionohet ne katin e pare te nje pallati me tete kate te ndodhur ne rrugen Petro Korcari me akses te menjehershem ne zonen e Komunes se Parisit dhe Vasil Shantos. 
Apartamenti ka planimetri shume te rregullt e cila organizohet ne ambient ndenje, dy dhoma gjumi, garderobe, dy tualete, ballkon perimetrik qe aksesohet nga te gjitha ambientet dhe gjithashtu ka edhe nje siperfaqe prej 65m2 oborr ne perdorim ku mund te sherbeje si parkim per 3 automjete. 
Prona sapo eshte investuar totalisht ne vetrata tripleks high quality, sistemi i ri elektrik, sistem i ri hidraulik me multistrat, tavani gipsi/patinime, dyer te brendshme filomur me lartesi 2.7m, tualete te rinovuara totalisht, hidrosanitare incaso etj, 
Prona ka nje lartesi te perfunduar prej 2.8m dhe eshte gati per mobilim. 
Per me shume informacione na kontaktoni.
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE NEAR THE MUNICIPALITY OF PARIS
description_en: The property is positioned on the first floor of an eight-story building located on Petro Korcari street with immediate access to the area of ​​the Municipality of Paris and Vasil Shantos. The apartment has a very regular floor plan, which is organized into a living room, two bedrooms, wardrobe, two toilets, a perimeter balcony that can be accessed from all rooms and also has a surface of 65m2 of usable yard where it can be used as parking for 3 vehicles. The property has just been fully invested in high quality triplex windows, new electrical system, new multi-layer hydraulic system, plaster/skate ceiling, 2.7m high filomur internal doors, completely renovated toilets, incaso sanitary ware, etc. The property has a finished height of 2.8m and is ready for furnishing. For more information, contact us.
